disagreements.title: Registration field should auto-capitalise and turn off spellcheck
disagreements.a_reason: A polish suggestion. The review shows no wrong entry or other harm to residents.
disagreements.b_reason: On a phone, autocorrect and lower-case entry can change a number plate as it is typed, and the gate checks the vehicle. Typing it is harder and errors are more likely. This is not seeded.

assertions.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
